model.title: To make technical amendments to update statutory references to certain provisions which were formerly classified to chapters 14 and 19 of title 25, United States Code, and to correct related technical errors.

summary.text: The bill would update legal references throughout the U.S. Code to reflect changes made in 2016 when Congress reorganized certain Indian law provisions in Title 25. It aims to correct outdated citations and related technical errors that resulted from that earlier reorganization.
